Replaces jobs skills based on the given `jobId`.
- All skills of each job will be replaced by the provided ones. For each job, a maximum of 100 skills is allowed.

params.name: skillId
params.description:
Filter on **skillId** property with LHS bracket notation.

Expected value format is a string.

params.name: status
params.description:
Filter on **status** property with LHS bracket notation.

Expected value format is a string (`toAssess`, `pendingValidation`, `validated`).

params.name: userId
params.description:
Filter on **userId** property with LHS bracket notation.

Expected value format is a valid ID (24 digits or letters).

params.name: status
params.description:
Filter on **status** property with LHS bracket notation.

Expected value format is a string (`archived`, `published`).

params.name: updatedAt
params.description:
Filter on **updatedAt** property with LHS bracket notation.

Expected value format is a date (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ). The milliseconds are always set to 0.
